title: LinkedIn Is Eating TikTok's Lunch — And Nobody's Talking About It
angle: LinkedIn quietly cloned TikTok's algorithm for AI content creators — and the engagement numbers are beating every other platform right now

scenes.voiceover: LinkedIn posts are hitting 10 million views. No followers. No ad spend. Just AI content.
scenes.visual_description: Bold white text slams onto black background. A real LinkedIn post counter ticking from 0 to 10M in 2 seconds.

scenes.voiceover: Three accounts started 60 days ago. All posting AI tips. Combined reach? 40 million impressions.
scenes.visual_description: Rapid-fire screen swipe through 3 LinkedIn profiles. Analytics screenshots flash with red circle callouts on view counts.

scenes.voiceover: LinkedIn changed its algorithm in 2024. It now rewards carousel posts and video — exactly like TikTok's For You page.
scenes.visual_description: Split-screen: TikTok FYP scroll on left vs LinkedIn feed scroll on right. Content formats mirror each other visually.

scenes.voiceover: AI content is the #1 category blowing up right now. Prompts, tools, workflows — LinkedIn's audience is hungry and untapped.
scenes.visual_description: Fast cuts of viral LinkedIn AI posts — ChatGPT tips, Midjourney carousels, automation workflows — each with massive engagement numbers.

scenes.voiceover: TikTok 2019. Instagram Reels 2021. LinkedIn AI content 2025. The early window is open — but not for long.
scenes.visual_description: Timeline graphic appears. TikTok and Reels eras flash with 'CLOSED' stamps. LinkedIn 2025 pulses with 'OPEN NOW' in green.

scenes.voiceover: So next time you see a LinkedIn post with 10 million views — that could be you. The platform is wide open.
scenes.visual_description: Screen returns to opening shot — post counter hitting 10M — but now a new name is on the profile. Viewer's name placeholder pulses.

hook_test.format_reference: Wait, what? — Hook with surprising claim → proof → bigger reveal
hook_test.viral_proof: This format mirrors 'TikTok is dying and THIS platform is replacing it' videos that consistently hit 10M-50M views in 2022-2024. The platform-vs-platform angle with receipts is a proven viral trigger. Example: Gary Vee's LinkedIn prediction clip (15M+ views), and multiple creator economy explainers using this exact structure averaging 12M views.
hook_test.why_it_works: Creators are obsessed with platform arbitrage. Telling them a blue-ocean opportunity exists RIGHT NOW triggers FOMO at a biological level. The receipts (real view counts) make it believable. The loop ending makes them rewatch to see if they missed a step.
